note: This project's own rules for Brigade's hooks (the plugin's hooks/workflow-config.mjs has the format). guard.block: commands the guard refuses; stopGate.checks: what a phase-run session must pass before it stops, in order ({base} is the run's base commit). The workflow's own rules (no --no-verify, no attribution trailer, the phase-run discipline) are built in and need no row. phaseRun: what the phase runner checks and pins for this project (template/tools/phase-run/config.mjs has the format).
